## What this changes

- **Scrub (HEAD-level, normal commits — no history rewrite):** commit
  `15085e0a` reintroduced four of the 32 gitignored listed personal handles
  into six retained-prefix files. All handle strings are replaced with
  non-identifying "pre-rekey handle" references + `as-of P37.61b / RULING E-1`
  markers (the positions name *deployed* ids — still pre-rekey pending
  `D-P34.18-1` — so the neutral ids would falsify the records). All
  `owner`/`item_owner` keys (3,621 lines) are stripped from the five declared
  ArcGIS catalog-sweep/disposition JSON artifacts; `reports/current/*`
  regenerated by the tool.
- **Reappearance guard (`sig.redaction-guard/1`):**
  `docs/build/tools/redaction_guard.py` + committed digest policy
  `docs/build/tools/record_policy/redaction_guard.json` (32 sha256 digests —
  the `source_aliases.json` precedent — never plaintext). Fail-closed on any
  listed handle in any tracked file *or path* including retained prefixes
  (substring-level digest comparison), any `item_owner` key anywhere, and any
  `owner`/`item_owner` key inside the declared sweep set. Wired as a named
  step in the CI docs job. `handle_crawl_check.py` keeps its informational
  retained/functional classification.
- **`memory_guard.py` attribution fix:** the `.jsonl` byte-`prefix` finding
  was emitted with no commit attribution in range mode, so the declared
  `seed-commit` mechanism could never cover a mid-line `.jsonl` repair. The
  finding now attributes to the commit that removed the first un-filled line
  (fallback to first-parent head / "" unchanged). One pinned test.
- **Sanctioned memory-repair:** pre-edit bytes archived under
  `docs/build/reports/memory-repair/` — with listed handles redacted to
  `sha256:` digests plus per-line `original-line-sha256` audit digests
  (plaintext handles never commit; the true bytes remain in git history
  per OD-20) — dated correction section in
  `docs/governance/identifier-rekey-note.md`, `seed-commit e3efcac5`
  declared in `record_policy/history.policy` (G10: this policy change +
  the `memory_guard.py`/`ci.yml` changes ride this PR).
